spans.s: ति (l) personal ending तिप् of the 3rd pers. sing.; (2) common term for the krt affixes क्तिन् and क्तिच् as also for the unadi affix ति; see क्तिन् and क्तिच्; (3) fem. affix ति added to the word युवन्. e. g. युवतिः cf.
; (4) tad. affix ति as found in the words पङ्क्ति and विंशति cf. Kas. on
; (5) tad. affix added to the word पक्ष in the sense of 'a root,' and to the words कम् and शम् in the sense of posses- sion (मत्वर्थे ); e.g. पक्षतिः, कन्तिः, शान्तिः, cf. Kas, on
, 138; (6) a technical term for the term गति in Panini's grammar, cf. उपसर्गाः क्रिया- योगे; गतिश्च
. The term ति for गति is used in the Jainendra Vyakarana.
